# cycle_environment (Data Source)

Looks up a Cycle environment by ID, name, or identifier.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an environment by name.
data "cycle_environment" "api" {
  name = "API"
}

# Or by its slugged identifier.
data "cycle_environment" "by_identifier" {
  identifier = "api"
}

# Or by its ID.
data "cycle_environment" "by_id" {
  id = "651efd54c53f7b6e2c5a9f21"
}

resource "cycle_scoped_variable" "api_token" {
  environment_id = data.cycle_environment.api.id
  identifier     = "API_TOKEN"
  value          = var.api_token
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The unique ID of the environment. Exactly one of `id`, `name`, or `identifier` must be set.
- `identifier` (String) The human-readable slugged identifier of the environment. Exactly one of `id`, `name`, or `identifier` must be set.
- `name` (String) The user-defined name of the environment. Exactly one of `id`, `name`, or `identifier` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `cluster` (String) The identifier of the cluster this environment is deployed into.
- `description` (String) The custom description of the environment.
- `hub_id` (String) The ID of the hub this environment belongs to.
- `legacy_networking` (Boolean) Whether legacy networking mode is enabled on this environment.
- `state` (String) The current state of the environment.
